title: Checked continuing array-fold body
summary: Composes the active array traversal guard and indexed load with a compiler-described scalar body, condition, continuation, and guarded back edge.
premises: A represented UInt64 input array and in-bounds logical index
Frame getters for the input pointer, encoded index, and effective stop
A generated equality from the loaded item frame to the scalar descriptor state
Compiler-derived body, condition, and continuing evaluator equations
Break 1 and Break 0 callbacks for the caller's invariant and measure
result: The active traversal edge loads the indexed element and executes the compiler-described scalar step through either Break 1 or the continuing back edge.
